sets.name: bytes
sets.doc: Kernel bytes: comparisons and the raw-bytes bridge (`Silmaril.Prelude.Bytes.Native`).

sets.name: elf
sets.doc:
ELF: the staged layout checker (`Silmaril.Elf`, registered there as `elf.layout`). Naming a
procedure here before it is registered is harmless: sets hold names.

sets.name: default
sets.doc: What the default profile runs natively.

procedures.name: bytes.sameBytes
procedures.doc:
Same bytes, by windows (`KBytes.toList_eq_of_sameBytes`). Kernel fallback measured at
about 55 ms per MiB with 64 KiB windows (benchmarks/kernel-bytes).

procedures.name: bytes.beq
procedures.doc:
Structural equality (`KBytes.toList_eq_of_beq`). The kernel fallback is cheap; `rfl` is
cheaper still on canonical trees.

procedures.name: bytes.wf
procedures.doc: Cached lengths are correct (`KBytes.wf`). Cheap in the kernel.

procedures.name: bytes.eqByteArray
procedures.doc:
Kernel bytes equal a `ByteArray` (`KBytes.toByteArray_eq_of_eqByteArray`). There is no
kernel fallback: the kernel would build both byte lists one cell per byte. For bytes from
`include_bytes`, use the structural bridge (`kbytes_rel`) instead, which needs no evaluation.

procedures.name: elf.loader
procedures.doc: The loader view (LoaderIs). Native: compiled fastRead over the file's ByteArray (trusts the compiler and runtime). Kernel: KBytes.readLE, checked by the kernel.

procedures.name: elf.layout
